purpose: Teach: 見送る/盗む/つど/痛快/くどい/本末転倒/滴/モニカ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お父さんを、絶対、駅まで、絶対、見送る、絶対、ね
lines.en: Mom, I'm serious — I'm definitely, absolutely going to see Dad off at the station, okay?
lines.style: Urgent, insistent vowels on each promise. Breathless with commitment. Eyes wide, willing her to understand the absolute seriousness. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、絶対、人のおやつ、絶対、盗む、絶対、ような、絶対、こと、絶対、しないでね
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — you absolutely cannot, under any circumstances, take other people's snacks, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but steady. Not scolding; stating a clear boundary. Calm authority that expects agreement. Eyes meeting his with quiet firmness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お友達と、絶対、会う、絶対、つど、絶対、ぼく、絶対、楽しいよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm serious — every single time I get to see my friends, I'm really happy!
lines.style: Genuine delight breaking through each word. Bright, unfiltered enthusiasm. Bouncing slightly in tone and posture. No performance — just true feeling.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、痛快、絶対、な、絶対、推理小説、絶対、好きなのよ、翔くん
lines.en: Your dad really does love those thrilling mystery novels, you know, Sho.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost to herself. Soft smile in the voice. Slow, fond pace — remembering something true about him. Trailing slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、ぼくの説明、絶対、くどい、絶対、ない?本気で
lines.en: Mom, am I being too long-winded when I explain things? I'm serious.
lines.style: Curious and uncertain, seeking honest feedback. Slight hesitation on the opening. Vulnerable underneath the question — genuinely wanting to know.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、ご褒美のために、絶対、勉強するのは、絶対、本末転倒、絶対、よ
lines.en: Sho, studying just for a reward is putting the cart before the horse. You understand?
lines.style: Quiet teaching moment. Thoughtful, not harsh. Speaking to his capability to understand something larger. Slight pause before the question at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、本気で、絶対、お庭の葉、絶対、雨の、絶対、滴、絶対、綺麗だよ
lines.en: Mom, the raindrops on the garden leaves are really beautiful, you know?
lines.style: Soft wonder. Genuine observation shared quietly, without performing it. Simple and present. Gazing inward slightly, voice tender.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ママのお友達、本気で、絶対、モニカ、絶対、さん、絶対、留学経験、絶対、あるのよ、翔くん
lines.en: My friend Monica has studied abroad, you know, Sho.
lines.style: Conversational sharing, not lecturing. Warm and matter-of-fact. Mentioning someone interesting she knows. Relaxed, almost thinking out loud with him.
